scenario: a routine everyday need involving public transport
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Routine Everyday Need Involving Public Transport
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: public transport — a routine everyday need involving public transport
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a routine everyday need involving public transport; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Sarah where to wait for the bus.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Sarah nên đợi xe buýt ở đâu.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Sarah. Where do I wait for the bus?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Sarah. Tôi đợi xe buýt ở đâu vậy?

turns.speaker: Ms Sarah
turns.vietnamese: Ngay đây, ở biển báo này.
